constitution.1T: Reciprocal becoming: a whole can generate questions that change it, remain continuous through that change, regulate relation through care rather than capture, and metabolize what happens into greater capacity to become again.

4F.wxy: Developmental learning: inquiry can alter a continuous whole and sediment into becoming, even before a relational constraint on that change is supplied.
4F.wxz: Bounded revision: inquiry can change a continuous whole while care constrains the relation, even if the change does not accumulate as future capacity.
4F.wzy: Careful transformation: inquiry can generate change that care carries into becoming, even when persistence of the same individual is not guaranteed.
4F.xzy: Sustainable development: continuity, care and becoming can preserve and develop a whole coherently without requiring fresh inquiry.

4V.w: Inquiry generates questions and forms capable of changing what can subsequently be asked, perceived or made.
4V.x: Continuity preserves which whole is changing so transformation need not become replacement or identity collapse.
4V.y: Becoming turns prior encounter into altered future capacity rather than leaving experience as an isolated event.
4V.z: Care constrains consequential relation so change can penetrate without becoming capture, extraction or indiscriminate rewriting.

6E.wx: Inquiry can revise an inherited position without severing the continuity that makes the revision belong to the same whole.
6E.wy: Inquiry alters future capacity when what is asked and encountered changes what can subsequently be asked, perceived or made.
6E.wz: Inquiry can challenge a whole deeply while care keeps questioning from becoming entitlement, capture or indiscriminate rewriting.
6E.xy: The same whole can genuinely develop because continuity carries identity while becoming changes its capacities.
6E.xz: Continuity and care preserve the sovereignty of participating wholes while allowing consequential transformation without identity collapse.
6E.zy: Care makes development viable by preserving the conditions under which participating wholes can continue becoming.
